In Bemidji, it’s remarkable to see how the community has come together and rebuilt after last year’s storm.

Thanks to the hard work of so many, Bemidji is standing strong and open for business.

bemidjipioneer.com/news/thro…

Wonderful to see the love and support for Savannah Guthrie on her return to the Today Show as we continue to keep her mom Nancy and their whole family in our prayers.

Video

Great to be at the University of Minnesota Duluth where incredible work is being done to improve treatment of Alzheimer’s and dementia.

I introduced a bipartisan bill to provide additional training for primary care providers because they are a key part of early detection.

Video

I met with workers and local leaders at Mesabi Metallics in Nashwauk — in a few months, it will become the first taconite mine to open in Minnesota in nearly 50 years. This is good news for the Iron Range, creating good-paying union jobs and new opportunities for working families.

Thanks to the Operating Engineers, Steelworkers, LIUNA, Ironworkers, Iron Range Building Trades, Tribal leaders, and mayors including Pete Hyduke of Hibbing and Greg Heybloom of Nashwauk & Ida Rukavina (my former staf

Thinking of Tom and his family tonight on the loss of his mom Patsy. She had a big family including many many grandkids and more who loved her. 🙏


Tom Emmer (@GOPMajorityWhip)

My mom, Patsy, decided today was her day to rise too. She passed peacefully this morning. I can see her right now smiling in the embrace of her love and my father, Tom, and my sister, Bridget. Our time together never was and never will be enough. Love your families today more than ever. On behalf of my brother Jack and s

NASA Artemis view from space today. FIRST TIME PHOTO. JUST RELEASED

(Credit: St. Paul Pioneer Press PEEPS 🐥 diorama  contest, Sue Baugus, “Give Peeps a Chance”)

The sun is shining across Minnesota today for Easter morning. A day of faith, family, and reflection. Always remember my mom singing Easter hymns in the church choir and her bunny breads at dinner. And dad? He always liked a good Easter afternoon hike, even in the cold! 🙏 ☀️ 🪺
Happy Easter! From our family to yours. A favorite photo of John and Abigail with their tie-dyed eggs. Wishing you a day filled with joy and time with loved ones.

So Trump is filing an “emergency” appeal to build his BALLROOM! How about fixing these “emergencies” first:  

1. A plan to end the war 
2. Ending harm inflicted by his tariffs  
3. Getting House Republicans to vote for TSA/FEMA funding plan supported by all 100 senators

Stopped by the Bemidji Fire Department to thank our firefighters and first responders for their dedication during last summer’s storm.

From emergency response to the long cleanup, they’ve been there every step of the way.
One year in, the administration's tariffs are taking a toll on Minnesota businesses and their customers.

At the Bemidji Fire Station, I presented Kev and Dave of KB101 with the Broadcasters Crystal Award for Community Service. KB101 is the only radio station in the country to win this award 7 times!!

Well-deserved recognition for their work keeping people safe and informed during last summer’s storm.

Anyone who has had a family member with Alzheimer's knows how hard that journey can be. We need to invest in finding a cure and improving care for Alzheimer's patients. I met with Duluth faculty and students at UMD medical school where they're advancing that mission for people in every zip code.

Video

Something nice to wake up to!


NASA (@NASA)

We see our home planet as a whole, lit up in spectacular blues and browns. A green aurora even lights up the atmosphere. That's us, together, watching as our astronauts make their journey to the Moon.





— https://nitter.net/NASA/status/2040059770237849635#m

Great to visit Central Lakes College in Brainerd with President Dr. Charlier and Mayor Badeaux to tour their dental program and more. Hands-on training at community and technical colleges prepares the next generation of workers for the jobs we need. 

brainerddispatch.com/news/lo…

Here in Duluth meeting with U of M doctors and researchers and looked out to see the Coast Guard ship Spar on its way to rescue this stranded-in-the-ice mammoth freighter. High drama on Lake Superior for anyone in Duluth right now! The cold and ice this week surprised everyone…

The President's budget request slashes funding for health care, our agriculture, and resources for families struggling with rising costs.

Completely misplaced priorities.

OK Minnesota, the snow is just a momentary spring setback! ❄️ 🌹 In Bemidji with the Mayor, Fire Chief, United Way & DNR to get briefed on last summer’s storm recovery & tree removal. Bemidji Strong is the real deal & the people stand as tall as Paul Bunyan & Babe the Blue Ox!
